SELECT

COUNT(*) AS total_agendamentos,

COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'concluido') AS total_concluidos,

COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'em_atendimento') AS em_atendimento,

COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pendente') AS pendentes,

ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'pendente'))::numeric, 1) AS sla_medio_minutos,

ROUND((MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'pendente'))::numeric, 1) AS sla_minimo_minutos,

ROUND((MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'pendente'))::numeric, 1) AS sla_maximo_minutos

FROM agendamentos

WHERE created_at >= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_inicio }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')

AND created_at <= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_fim }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE remetente = 'agente') AS msgs_agente,
  COUNT(DISTINCT split_part(telefone, '@', 1)) AS pacientes_unicos
FROM historico_conversas
WHERE created_at >= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_inicio }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
  AND created_at <= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_fim }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')

  -- Ignora meus números de teste
  AND split_part(telefone, '@', 1) NOT IN (
      '554888720983',
      '554899314665'
  );

SELECT
    convenio,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS percentual
FROM agendamentos
WHERE created_at >= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_inicio }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
AND created_at <= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_fim }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')

AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554888720983%'
AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554899314665%'

AND convenio IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY convenio
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS hora,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM agendamentos
WHERE created_at >= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_inicio }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
AND created_at <= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_fim }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')

AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554888720983%'
AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554899314665%'

GROUP BY hora
ORDER BY hora;

SELECT
    servico,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM agendamentos
WHERE created_at >= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_inicio }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
AND created_at <= ('{{ $('Coleta periodo').first().json.data_fim }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')

AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554888720983%'
AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554899314665%'

AND servico IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY servico
ORDER BY total DESC;

SELECT
    nome,
    tipo_solicitacao,
    status,
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at)) / 60)::int AS minutos_espera
FROM agendamentos
WHERE status IN ('pendente', 'em_atendimento')

AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554888720983%'
AND telefone NOT LIKE '%554899314665%'

ORDER BY created_at ASC;
